what: In the cloud container that ran PR 1636's steps, the lint:promise-types part of pnpm lint died in a full pnpm lint run four times across two steps: three times with a tsgo 'Unexpected EOF' and a kill for lack of memory (the tests step), and once with 'EPIPE: broken pipe' thrown from typescript 7.0.2's sync channel at oxlint-plugins/promise-types.ts:603 (the build step). Each time the part passed alone (pnpm -s lint:promise-types, 0 findings), and full runs before and after passed. This is the second time it was seen, so it owes a root cause and a ticket.
fix: lint:promise-types reports a dead tsgo child as its own error with the memory it had, and lint's runner keeps it out of parallel with the other heavy parts when memory is short, so a box run fails with a reason instead of a broken pipe.
test: A full pnpm lint in the same cloud container shape passes ten runs in a row, or fails with a message that names the memory limit.
